command:
export LBL=c8g-16t THREADS=16
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
LBL="${LBL:-unknown}"; THREADS="${THREADS:-16}"
tar -xf salmon-index.tar

CG=/sys/fs/cgroup
sample(){ : > /tmp/samp.tsv
  while :; do printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$(date +%s)" \
    "$(cat $CG/memory.current 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" \
    "$(awk '/^anon /{print $2}' $CG/memory.stat 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" \
    "$(awk '/^usage_usec/{print $2}' $CG/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" >> /tmp/samp.tsv
    sleep 1; done; }
sample & SP=$!; trap 'kill $SP 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

echo "== salmon quant: the COMPLETE ERR188026 run, library type inferred =="
T0=$(date +%s)
salmon quant -i sidx -l A -1 ERR188026_1.fastq.gz -2 ERR188026_2.fastq.gz -o squant -p "$THREADS" > quant.log 2>&1 \
  || { tail -25 quant.log; exit 1; }
T1=$(date +%s); WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))
kill $SP 2>/dev/null || true
cp squant/quant.sf quant.sf
cp squant/aux_info/meta_info.json meta_info.json

NTX=$(awk 'NR>1{n++} END{print n+0}' quant.sf)
TPMSUM=$(awk 'NR>1{s+=$4} END{printf "%.2f", s}' quant.sf)
NREADSUM=$(awk 'NR>1{s+=$5} END{printf "%.0f", s}' quant.sf)
# This image has no python and no jq -- parse the JSON with sed, which it does have.
# One awk, no pipe: reads to EOF and keeps the FIRST match. `sed ... | head -1` here
# would usually win the race on a small file and SIGPIPE on a big one; racy beats broken
# only in the sense of being harder to catch, so there is no pipe at all.
jnum(){ awk -v k="$1" 'index($0, "\"" k "\"") && v=="" { s=$0; sub(/^.*:[ \t]*/,"",s); sub(/[^0-9.].*$/,"",s); v=s } END{ print v }' meta_info.json; }
MAPPED=$(jnum num_mapped)
TOTREADS=$(jnum num_processed)
RATE=$(jnum percent_mapped)
PEAK=$(awk -F'\t' '{if($2+0>m)m=$2+0} END{printf "%.2f", m/1073741824}' /tmp/samp.tsv)
CORES=$(awk -F'\t' 'NR==1{u=$4;t=$1} END{printf "%.2f", ($4-u)/1e6/($1-t)}' /tmp/samp.tsv)

{
printf 'label\t%s\n' "$LBL"
printf 'salmon_version\t%s\n' "$(salmon --version 2>&1 | awk '{print $NF}')"
printf 'threads\t%s\n' "$THREADS"
printf 'quant_wall_s\t%s\n' "$WALL"
printf 'reads_processed\t%s\n' "$TOTREADS"
printf 'reads_mapped\t%s\n' "$MAPPED"
printf 'percent_mapped\t%s\n' "$RATE"
printf 'transcripts\t%s\n' "$NTX"
printf 'tpm_sum\t%s   (assert 1000000.00 -- EXACT, TPM is a per-million share)\n' "$TPMSUM"
printf 'numreads_sum\t%s   (assert == reads_mapped -- CONSERVATION)\n' "$NREADSUM"
printf 'reads_per_sec\t%s\n' "$(awk -v n="$TOTREADS" -v w="$WALL" 'BEGIN{printf "%.0f", n/w}')"
printf 'peak_rss_gib\t%s\n' "$PEAK"
printf 'avg_cores\t%s\n' "$CORES"
} | tee "size-$LBL.txt"

awk -v s="$TPMSUM" 'BEGIN{ d=s-1000000; if (d<0) d=-d; if (d>1.0) { printf "TPM sums to %s, not 1e6\n", s; exit 1 } }'
test "$NREADSUM" = "$MAPPED" || { echo "sum(NumReads)=$NREADSUM != num_mapped=$MAPPED"; exit 1; }
test "$TOTREADS" -gt 5000000 || { echo "only $TOTREADS reads -- not a full run"; exit 1; }
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
